title: Reviews
subtitle: The requests sent to customers after their visit. Google profile reviews will appear here once the account is linked.
offNotice: The review request is off: switch it on from Settings → Reviews.
noPlaceId: The Google profile Place ID is missing: without it the link does not exist and nothing goes out. Set it from Settings → Reviews.
empty: No request yet: when a table closes its visit the customer gets the review link, and the request appears here.
settingsHint: Times, recipients and Place ID are set from Settings → Reviews.
